scope: Catholic Interracial Council research led to six missing Fort Deposit/Hayneville detainees. Local accumulation toward the next 100-person PR.

sncc1965.label: SNCC, August 20-21, 1965 incident reports, especially detailed report on PDF page 5 (visually verified). Names six people released after the August 14 arrests. Early reports contain corrected shooting details; no birth year is inferred from reported ages.

morrisroe.label: Richard Morrisroe, autobiographical Civil Rights Movement Veterans profile (2017): CIC membership, August 14 arrest and almost a week in jail.

daniels_archive.label: Archives of the Episcopal Church: Jonathan Daniels, ESCRU member; explicitly six days in Hayneville jail.

daniels_vitals.label: Encyclopedia of Alabama, Jonathan Myrick Daniels, by Rebecca Woodham: March 20, 1939 birth and August 20, 1965 death after release.

ruby.label: SNCC Digital Gateway, Ruby Sales: July 8, 1948 birthday and SNCC organizing work; incorporates her Library of Congress oral history.

court1965.label: McMeans v. Mayor's Court, 247 F.Supp.606, September 30, 1965. Primary finding that the demonstration was peaceful and the permit ordinance unconstitutional as applied; dismissal. Full petitioner roster not printed, so no individual disposition inferred for these six.

nps.label: National Park Service, Jonathan Daniels Murder Site: August 20 release followed by shooting; death occurred after custody.

map.label: Hayneville municipality coordinates, 32.18222,-86.57861. Approximate town marker only, not exact historical jail footprint.

prisoner.name: Richard Morrisroe

cases.sentence: Pretrial detention at Lowndes County Jail, Hayneville; released August 20, 1965. No individual sentencing judgment verified.
